_comment: C2 regression fixture. Both relation_includes keys name a relation that does not exist: `nonexistent_rel` on no type at all (wildcard scope), and `nonexistent_rel_2` on the explicitly named `wider_region`. Before the fix, the per-type `select(has($namedRel))` skipped every type, leaving the rule vacuously satisfied — a consumer could name a relation the model has never had and be told the contract holds.
